title: NEO GOLF Tournament Dashboard — data interface (v0.1, design-only)
description: Describes how a future dashboard reads EXISTING, already-produced artifacts read-only. Every field is traced to its real producing module/script; a field with no current producer is marked available:false with the reason, never invented. No field here implies a new script, table, or migration.

header.description: Source: the loaded stage's frozen snapshot file (BETA #001: klpga.neo_win.archive.NeoWinPredictionSnapshot; BETA #001-C: klpga.neo_win.beta001c_archive.NeoWinCPredictionSnapshot).

stage.source: derived from prediction_id suffix — '001'/'001-C'=PRE, '001-R1'=R1; R2/R3/FINAL have no producing script yet (available: false)

main_table_row.description: One per field player for the loaded stage. Source is per-property below; a property with available:false must render '--', never a computed guess.

player_code.note: the ONLY safe join key across stages/artifacts — never join by player_name (see klpga.neo_win.identity_resolution)

current_position.reason: no live-leaderboard-to-prediction join exists in this repo today

change_pct_points.source: current_stage neo_win_pct - prior_stage neo_win_pct, matched by player_code (klpga.neo_win.comparison.compare_beta001_to_beta001c is the existing precedent for this exact computation, though it compares 001 vs 001-C specifically)
change_pct_points.null_reason: player absent from the prior stage's frozen snapshot

neo_signal.reason: NO existing NEO SIGNAL RISING/STABLE/FALLING threshold specification found anywhere in this repository as of this schema version — not implemented, not guessed. change_pct_points alone may be shown.

make_cut_pct.source: klpga.neo_win.round_update — PRE/#001-C have no cut-probability field

top10_pct.reason: no script in this repo computes a TOP-10 probability today — only WIN %

final_round_pct.reason: no script in this repo computes this today

identity_status.source: klpga.neo_win.identity_resolution.build_full_identity_crosswalk, joined by player_code — shown, never hidden, for non-CLEAN rows

player_detail.description: Superset of main_table_row for one player, plus the Performance Profile.

performance_profile.description: Source (BETA #001-C only, snapshot.predictions[i].feature_values): a key absent or null means the model itself had no data for that player/domain that season — render exactly 'N/A', never estimated.
performance_profile.note: feature_values.neo_scoring is intentionally never surfaced here — always None by design (duplicate representation of career scoring), per klpga.neo_win.feature_matrix's documented exclusion.

validation_result.description: Computed once per loaded stage, before any row renders as valid model output (spec Section 6).

identity_clean_preferred.note: non-CLEAN rows are still shown (identity_status field), this flag only gates the overall stage banner

threads_card.description: Section 8 — MUST be derived from the same already-validated main_table_row list the dashboard rendered, never re-queried or hand-typed.

top10.source: main_table[] sorted by neo_win_pct desc, first 10, taken AFTER validation_result.overall_status == 'VALID'
